heldOut.reason: Training-signal contamination: this task is authored about the tree the round-2 prompt was written in, and its F1-F7 anchor on the same line set (src/llm.ts:667, src/rlm.ts:436, src/rlm.ts:438, src/llm.ts:563, src/mcp/server.ts:487, src/cli.ts:35, src/config.ts:122) that parity/round2/recursion-recon.md §2/§3/§4 is built from. F6 anchors src/cli.ts:35, whose verified text exists only because the same change corrected src/settings.ts. Selecting on it would tune the prompt against ground truth authored by the investigation that produced the prompt — a self-consistency loop, not a training signal. Kept as a held-out diagnostic.

Training-signal contamination by root: authored about the same working tree the round-2 prompt was written in, by the same author, in the same sitting. Its anchor files (src/khal-provider.ts) are not the recursion-recon line set, so the loop is looser than task 1's — but 'same tree, same author, same sitting' is the condition the disjointness test exists to break, and a fitness set should not have to argue about degree. Kept as a held-out diagnostic.

fitnessSet.contract: an optimizer may compute fitness only over `included`; `heldOut` tasks are diagnostics and scoring them is reporting, never selection
